godot_forward: -Z in the file; no turn needed (the file is in centimetre-like units, so the visual definition scales it by 0.0044)
collision_recommendation: Use simple BoxShape3D/CapsuleShape3D or custom RTS footprint data; do not use render mesh collision per unit.
source_pipeline: Sketchfab glTF-binary download (1k textures, 80.8k triangles). The loose display rocket was removed, then reduced with glTF-Transform and meshoptimizer: meshes merged by material, sloppy simplification to ~16k triangles, textures resized to 256 px WebP, origin at the bottom centre. Credit in godot/project/credits.json.
